query: SELECT empresaSlug, SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as sem_cat9, SUM(cat9) as cat9_dpote, SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) as total_com_cat9 FROM faturamentos WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2026 AND MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 5 GROUP BY empresaSlug;
